meta.description: Bends paths at a few spots, like a stem that changes its direction a little where a branch grows out. Gives the bent paths and the kinks as points, with their direction pointing to the outer side of the bend.

plant.description: The paths to bend. Only the deepest paths bend, the others are passed on.

amount.description: How many kinks every path gets.

lowest_kink.description: Where the first kink sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highest_kink.description: Where the last kink sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

angle.description: How far the path bends at every kink, in radians. Everything above the kink turns by it.

rotation.description: How far every kink is turned around the path from the one before it, in radians. 3.1416 rad bends left and right in turn, 2.3998 rad makes a spiral.
